Words in motion

Played words settle here. A warm halo marks words that can become another word with one letter change.
How this quiet race works
  • Place connected words across or down. Your first word must cover one of the four tinted center squares.
  • Letter values and premium squares score traditionally; playing all seven rack tiles adds 50 points.
  • Land a new tile on an SW square to earn a swap tile. There are 6 on Easy, 4 on Medium, and 3 on Hard, and each can be used once.
  • Tap ↻, then swipe a settled board letter away. Place any rack tiles normally — you can extend the word — then play it. A valid swap sends the removed letter to your opponent; invalid changes restore it without spending the swap.
  • When at least 7 tiles remain in the bag, glide any number of rack tiles onto it, then exchange them to end your turn.
  • The drawable bag starts with 68 nonblank tiles on Easy, 83 on Medium, and 98 on Hard. One blank is reserved for each side and joins that side’s first refill after it has drawn at least 14 tiles, keeping the full game at 70, 85, or 100 tiles.
  • When a rack empties, play stops and that player captures the value of the opponent’s remaining tiles. Highest score wins; ties are shared wins.
  • Completed level scores carry into the series. The first side to 1,000 cumulative points wins.
  • Press and hold a settled board word to open its Merriam-Webster reference.
